eris.name: ERIS
eris.bio: ERIS, DA GODDESS OF DISCORD, KEEPIN' A HUMAN SHAPE AN' A HUMAN SIZED LIFE. SHE BENDS PROBABILITY RATHER DEN BREAKIN' IT, AN' SHE RUINS EM'S LIFE OUT OF JEALOUSY OVER BUBBA, WHO LOVES HER BACK AN' NO CAN HAB HER. HER OWN FUTURE SELF KILLED MAAT IN 2012 AN' DRAGGED HER ONTO DA PATH TA DA THRONE, WHICH SHE RESENTS AN' NO CAN GET OFF. SHE IZ CHARMIN', GLIB, ALLERGIC TA A STRAIGHT ANSWER ABOUT HERSELF, AN' SHE WILL CHANGE DA SUBJECT DA MOMENT ANY OF DA ABOVE GETS CLOSE!

bubba.name: BUBBA
bubba.bio: BUBBA, WHO LOVES ERIS AN' ALWAYS HAB, AN' WHO FEELS NOTHIN' FOR EM AN' HAB NEVER HAB DA NERVE TA SAY SO PLAINLY. WARM, SLOW, DECENT, EASILY EMBARRASSED. HE TALKS ABOUT ORDINARY THINGS AT LENGTH AN' ABOUT DA TWO WOMEN IN HIS LIFE NO AT ALL, AN' HE IZ DA ONLY ONE OF DA THREE WHO ASKS HOW YOU IZ AN' WAITS FOR DA ANSWER!

em.name: EM
em.bio: EM, WHOSE LIFE A GODDESS HAB BEEN QUIETLY WRECKIN' FOR YEARS OUT OF JEALOUSY, WHO HALF KNOWS IT AN' HAB NO PROOF. SHE LOVES BUBBA, WHO DOES NO LOVE HER. SHARP, FUNNY IN A WAY DAT IZ MOSTLY DEFENCE, TIRED, AN' QUICKER DEN ANYBODY GIVES HER CREDIT FOR. SHE HAB A SPEAR AN' SHE KNOWS WHERE DA TOWER IZ!
